mood: warm-white close cafe tabletop under one broad diffuse window

reference_cluster.selection_rule: restrained complete serving assembly with tabletop air, edge-cropped waffle and magazine, diffuse white-room space

key_light.source: one very large upper-left diffuse window
key_light.relative_size: very large, producing broad highlights and long feathered penumbrae

ambient_fill: neutral room bounce below the key; retain floor grout, table texture and contact depth

screen_light_map.falloff: broad directional upper-left to lower-right falloff across one continuous matte tabletop
screen_light_map.gobo_geometry: two or three amorphous 3-8 percent opacity off-frame occupancy modulations only; no readable silhouette

specular_contract.highlight_shape: broad upper-left arcs on glass or ceramic with protected white detail
specular_contract.rim_continuity: continuous readable upper rim with no melted or broken vessel edge
specular_contract.transparent_caustic: subtle and physically connected only when the preserved source container is transparent

shadow_contract.edge: compact attached core opening into a long feathered penumbra
shadow_contract.attachment: each present cup, saucer and source spoon owns a separate but directionally coherent contact
shadow_contract.transparent_material: curved-wall refraction, Fresnel edge response and a restrained beverage-colored transmitted lift stay connected to the cast-shadow footprint

contact_shadow.behavior: compact neutral-gray attachment directly beneath each present support contact

cast_shadow.behavior: one lower-right shadow per object with a penumbra 0.28-0.52 of local caster width

transmitted_light.behavior: restrained source-beverage-colored lift only inside the physically connected transparent shadow

capture_contract.hdr: restrained social-photo HDR with protected white detail and no halo
capture_contract.texture: matte table, protected glass and cream, paper fiber and faint grain

reference_anchor.role: user-approved scene-condition anchor with novelty requirement

camera_coupling.support_plane: light preserves the raised circular table edge against the lower gray floor
camera_coupling.shadow_projection: product and environmental shadows project consistently from upper left toward lower right across both planes
camera_coupling.depth_response: falloff, edge height and receding floor grout remain readable under an 82-88 degree camera pitch

color_separation.shadow_neutral: quiet neutral to faintly cool gray
color_separation.material_locality: source-authoritative beverage color, ice and garnish remain inside the reconstructed drink; sidewall branding is not forced at the overhead camera, and opaque adopted-cup exteriors remain clean
